Business Development Manager — Post-Consumer Recyclable Plastics

Be part of something special. Join Vanden.

Vanden is a global plastics recycling business with operations across Europe, Asia, and the USA. Since 2005, we’ve built a strong international trading network and long-term partnerships with collectors, processors, and manufacturers — helping turn plastic waste into valuable, high-quality commodities.

We’re now looking for an experienced and commercially driven Business Development Manager to develop strategic partnerships across the post-consumer plastics supply chain and secure long-term commercial agreements with major industry players.

About the Role

In this role, you will build strong relationships with collectors, sorters (MRFs & PRFs), and re-processors handling post-consumer plastics, developing recurring revenue streams through secure supply and purchase agreements.

You’ll identify opportunities, shape commercial strategies, and work collaboratively with global teams to integrate Vanden’s service and value proposition into key customer operations.

Success in this role requires a disciplined approach to relationship management, excellent negotiation capability, and the ability to manage multiple opportunities and stakeholder relationships simultaneously in a fast-moving environment.

This role is suited to an experienced commercial or business development professional with a proven track record of closing long-term deals with large clients.

What You’ll Do

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, develop, and execute long-term purchase and sales agreements for post-consumer plastics
  • Build strategic relationships with large key clients and industry partners
  • Conduct research, outreach, networking, and market engagement across industry channels
  • Enhance existing supplier and customer relationships to increase volumes and margins
  • Carry out site visits to assess material suitability and quality requirements
  • Actively manage commercial and operational risk in collaboration with internal teams

Commercial Delivery & Market Engagement

  • Use effective negotiation strategies to overcome objections and secure deals
  • Stay up-to-date on market activity, competitor movements, and pricing trends
  • Share customer feedback and market insights with internal stakeholders
  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen sales operations

Reporting & CRM

  • Maintain accurate CRM records of all customer and supplier activity
  • Produce regular market and activity reports for leadership
  • Support development of standard operating procedures to improve workflow

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Background

  • Significant experience in Sales or Business Development, ideally in:
    • post-consumer plastics, recycling, waste management, or commodities trading
    • or selling into large industrial or manufacturing organisations
  • Proven success developing major accounts and securing long-term agreements
  • Strong experience managing complex negotiations
  • Track record in both new business and account development
  • Experience using CRM systems and managing structured sales pipelines
  • Self-driven, commercially minded, and results-focused

Skills & Capabilities

  • Able to build rapport at senior stakeholder levels
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking ability
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills
  • Highly organised with strong time-management discipline
  • Able to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
  • Comfortable working collaboratively across global teams
  • Confident presenting and communicating in writing and in person
  • Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Outlook, Word)

Business Development Manager – Recycled Plastics

Remote Position – United States

About the Business

Operating across 3 continents and trading in more than 20 countries, our client is a global leader in recyclable plastics trading and processing. Since establishing our recycling facility in the United Kingdom in 2017, this business has specialised in the collection, processing, and recycling of plastic waste generated by manufacturing, packaging, and warehousing industries worldwide.

As part of international expansion, we are seeking a commercially driven Business Development Manager to develop and grow their presence across the United States and LATAM markets.

Ideal Profile

  • A proactive communicator who enjoys building relationships and closing deals.
  • Results-driven with a strong interest in sales, commodities trading, and business development.
  • Confident making outbound calls, negotiating with customers, and identifying opportunities.
  • Commercially minded, analytical, and quick-thinking.
  • Naturally curious with a passion for researching new markets, customers, and industry trends.
  • A collaborative team player who works effectively across international teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global trading environment.

Key Responsibilities

Market Research & Business Development

Identify and develop new business opportunities across the US and LATAM recyclable plastics markets through research, networking, and outbound outreach.

Sales Support & Trading Operations

Prepare and distribute material offers to customers globally while supporting trading activities and sales strategy execution.

Customer Relationship Management

Manage inbound inquiries, conduct cold outreach, negotiate pricing, and build long-term relationships with suppliers and buyers.

CRM & Market Intelligence

Maintain accurate CRM records, monitor market trends, track customer activity, and analyse sales performance data.

Negotiation & Deal Execution

Support the full trading cycle from prospecting through negotiation and deal closure while learning the dynamics of global plastics commodities markets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with commercial leadership, logistics, and operations teams to ensure smooth execution of transactions and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Experience in sales, business development, trading, or customer-facing roles (B2B experience preferred).
  • Hunter mentality with confidence in outbound calling, email campaigns, and LinkedIn prospecting.
  • Strong commercial awareness and interest in recycling, sustainability, commodities, or circular economy industries.
  • Ability to analyse market data, identify trends, and think strategically.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively across diverse international markets.
  • Spanish or Portuguese language skills are a plus for LATAM market development.
  • Highly organized with strong time management and multitasking abilities.

For more information contact:

Jenny Böhnlein

Location: Remote (UK-wide / Flexible)

Astrantia Talent is partnering with a growing organisation in the plastics recycling and materials sector to appoint a high-performing Business Development Manager.

Jenny Böhnlein

Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Mechanical Engineer to join our Fuel Recycling Team.

Position Description

As a Mechanical Engineer supporting our nuclear waste treatment systems, you will develop waste processing equipment from concept through deployment. Rather than performing detailed equipment design yourself, you will define process and mechanical requirements, work closely with equipment vendors, and ensure systems are practical, maintainable, and ready for operation in a nuclear environment.

You will translate waste processing objectives into equipment requirements, operating concepts, vendor specifications, and acceptance criteria while evaluating designs for maintainability, reliability, contamination control, remote operation, and regulatory compliance. Success in this role requires sound mechanical engineering judgment, an understanding of industrial process equipment, and the ability to recognize when a design is overly complex, under-specified, or not ready for production use.

This role on the waste engineering team works closely with process engineering, mechanical design, controls, safety, radiation protection, licensing, procurement, operations, and external vendors to deliver integrated waste treatment systems.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Develop mechanical requirements, equipment specifications, acceptance criteria, and operating concepts for radioactive waste treatment systems.
  • Translate process requirements into practical equipment solutions for waste processing, packaging, storage, and material handling.
  • Evaluate vendor designs for functionality, maintainability, reliability, contamination control, remote operation, and lifecycle performance.
  • Develop and review equipment layouts, P&IDs, material handling flows, tooling concepts, and mechanical interfaces.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify designs, improve operability, reduce maintenance burden, and increase production readiness.
  • Support procurement by finding relevant vendors, preparing technical specifications, evaluating vendor proposals, and reviewing design deliverables.
  • Lead or participate in multidisciplinary design reviews and drive technical action items to closure.
  • Develop engineering documentation including design bases, interface definitions, design evaluations, and technical reports.
  • Support hazard analyses, licensing activities, commissioning, and facility integration.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering field
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant engineering experience
  • Experience developing, specifying, integrating, or implementing industrial process equipment
  • Experience working with equipment vendors, technical specifications, procurement packages, or design reviews
  • Experience with 3D CAD tools, 2D fabrication drawings, equipment specifications, and controlled design documentation
  • Familiarity with P&IDs, mechanical equipment layouts, process equipment interfaces, material handling concepts, and vendor design packages
  • Strong mechanical engineering judgment, including practical understanding of maintainability, reliability, fabrication, inspection, and failure modes
  • Experience coordinating work across multiple engineering disciplines
  • Ability to produce clear, traceable technical documentation in support of design development, procurement, safety review, or licensing activities

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience in nuclear, chemical processing, mining, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industrial facilities
  • Experience in commercial nuclear, DOE, advanced reactor, fuel cycle, waste treatment, or high-reliability industrial projects
  • Experience with radioactive waste processing, packaging, containerization, storage, or disposal systems in a hot-cell environment
  • Experience developing equipment for size reduction, compaction, filtration, solidification, packaging, container handling, drum handling, cask/canister interfaces, or remote/assisted maintenance
  • Familiarity with waste characterization, waste acceptance criteria, contamination control, ALARA principles, or radiological work planning
  • Familiarity with radioactive waste classification, regulation, or nuclear material packaging requirements
  • Experience with design for manufacturability, design for automation, or design for remote handling and maintainability
  • Experience with Solidworks
  • Experience supporting hazard analysis, failure modes analysis, commissioning, readiness reviews, or startup of industrial process systems

Competencies

We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer who is:

  • Practical, production-focused, and able to distinguish between a concept that works on paper and a system that can be operated and maintained
  • Experienced in mechanical design of industrial process equipment, material handling systems, packaging systems, and waste processing equipment
  • Comfortable translating process objectives into equipment requirements, vendor specifications, operating sequences, and acceptance criteria
  • Skilled at reviewing P&IDs, equipment layouts, mechanical interfaces, and vendor drawings
  • Able to identify maintainability, reliability, operability, and implementation risks early in design
  • Effective working across engineering disciplines and with external suppliers
  • Comfortable driving technical issues to resolution in a fast-paced development environment
  • Clear and direct in written and verbal communication, including design review comments and technical documentation
  • Energized by developing safe, compliant, and practical systems for radioactive waste processing and handling
  • Willing to propose creative, technically grounded solutions rather than relying only on precedent

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $120,000-$170,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Mechanical Designer to join our Fuel Recycling Engineering team.

Position Description

The person in this role is responsible for developing detailed mechanical designs, 3D CAD models, fabrication drawings, and prototype hardware supporting Oklo's first-of-a-kind nuclear fuel recycling technology. This work directly supports the development of advanced electrochemical processing equipment used to close the nuclear fuel cycle.

This position is heavily focused on translating engineering concepts into practical, manufacturable hardware. Working closely with mechanical, process, nuclear, materials, and controls engineers, the Mechanical Designer will create production-quality CAD models and drawing packages for custom equipment ranging from benchtop prototypes to production-scale process systems.

The ideal candidate enjoys designing hardware that gets built, working directly with machinists and fabricators, and iterating designs through hands-on prototyping and testing.

The equipment developed will operate in high-temperature (>500 °C), chemically aggressive, and high-radiation environments and includes molten salt vessels, high-temperature furnaces, gloveboxes, hot cells, tooling, fixtures, remote handling equipment, and other custom process hardware.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Develop detailed 3D CAD models and manufacturing drawings using SolidWorks.

  • Produce fabrication, assembly, weldment, machining, and installation drawings suitable for manufacturing and procurement.

  • Translate engineering concepts into manufacturable mechanical designs with strong attention to detail.

  • Apply Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles throughout the design process.

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, machinists, welders, and fabrication vendors to optimize designs for manufacturing, assembly, and maintenance.

  • Develop custom mechanical assemblies, fixtures, tooling, furnace components, vessels, and supporting process equipment.

  • Support prototype fabrication by responding to shop questions, incorporating manufacturing feedback, and revising drawings as designs evolve.

  • Maintain engineering documentation including bills of materials, drawing revisions, and controlled CAD files.

  • Participate in design reviews and contribute practical fabrication and assembly recommendations.

  • Assist with prototype assembly, equipment integration, and iterative design improvements based on testing and operational feedback.

  • Help develop CAD standards, drawing templates, and design best practices that improve consistency across the engineering organization.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Associate's degree, technical certification, or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Design, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Drafting, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).

  • 5+ years of experience developing detailed mechanical designs and fabrication drawings.

This position will lead to oversee the development of recycling system expansion and optimization and will lead the strategy and development of collection and processing initiatives to achieve the recycling targets prescribed in regulations (e.g., increasing material access, supporting the use of new sorting and/or recycling equipment). This position will also oversee material data acquisition, especially through waste composition analysis (i.e. characterization), and would support downstream reporting requirements across multiple states in the U.S.

Strategic Planning and Development

  • Support states in developing key strategies to work with MRFs to on-ramp materials and provide detailed guidance and analysis to enable investments to proceed at the state level.
  • Support third-party large-scale investments that impact multiple states (i.e. secondary sortation) and drive alignment with the states.

Interest-Holder Engagement

  • Responsible for engaging with recycling and materials trade associations, service providers, and other key interest holders to support materials collection and processing strategy development and implementation (in partnership with state teams).

  • Develop and manage the budget for materials strategy collection and processing initiatives, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and meet key performance indicators.

Team Leadership

  • Oversee, manage, delegate tasks, and motivate a team of industry professionals to accelerate system performance improvement and investments, primarily focused on plastics.

Since our client started on their journey in 2005, they have developed a worldwide presence, serving hundreds of customers in over 50 countries. They have grown a strong, talented team who are highly trained, dedicated and loyal. They are headquartered in Hong Kong with operations and representation in Australia, Finland, Ireland, Turkey, Spain, Netherlands & UK. They operate a factory based in the UK specialising in the collection and recycling of plastic waste generated from industry and manufacturing.

Job Summary

Your role will be to procure and sell recycled plastics, with a particular focus on PET (rPET). You will be working closely with local and global teams, communicating with colleagues across the world every day, a highly collaborative and entrepreneurial mindset are key to being a top performer. You will develop relationships with material suppliers & buyers, assess their capabilities for a fit with our client's strategy and market demands.

Being able to manage ongoing negotiations, incoming new opportunities and customer development all at the same time makes this role suitable for a skilled business development executive who is results driven and uses time effectively. Success is achieved through a disciplined and consistent approach to building relationships, utilising the CRM and hunting for your own leads to keep a full pipeline of opportunities.

The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-moving environment, react quickly to changing priorities, be able to follow internal processes and proactively manage risk. An excellent communicator, you will demonstrate an optimistic and persistent approach, always open to giving and receiving feedback on performance. Challenges are seen as an opportunity to learn. This role is suited to an ambitious individual who is motivated, goal driven and wants to be part of a values driven organisation in a growth industry.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business Development & Delivery

  • Map the market and develop new suppliers & buyers from manufacturing (fibre, sheet & film), recycling & waste sectors.
  • Assess client suitability against strategy, quality requirements & size of opportunity.
  • Develop purchasing contracts for regular volumes of waste and recycled materials (particularly PET or rPET).
  • Execute sales for scrap & recycled PET (rPET) sourced from our client's global locations to licensed manufacturers and recyclers.
  • Actively seek out new opportunities and conduct market research through research, cold calling, networking, social media, attending conferences and trade fairs.
  • Maximise margin by using effective negotiation techniques.
  • Able to challenge customer views and counter objections to move towards closing a deal.
  • Actively engage with the greater team to develop skills and share knowledge.
  • Perform site visits to qualify, build relationships and discover market information.
  • Develop and enhance relationships by being creative, innovative and offering excellent service that is responsive and tailored to client needs.
  • Engage in constant and active risk management, to ensure the material is per the company and customer quality requirements.

Reporting & Management

  • Keep detailed logs in CRM of all activities constantly.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer information in CRM, including material requirements.
  • Provide feedback & market reports to Management.
  • Use knowledge of competitors and market to develop our client’s unique selling propositions.
  • Contribute to developing standard operating procedures to mitigate risk and ensure seamless workflow.

Requirements

Person Specification

Knowledge (Education & Related Experience)

  • At least 5 years’ experience in business development in raw materials supply.
  • Experience in recycled plastic or prime PET an advantage, not a requirement.
  • Experience of developing new accounts and long term contracts.

Skills & Abilities

  • Multilingual (fluent English is a requirement).
  • Able to use logic and reasoning to appraise situations .
  • Able to anticipate opportunities and risks.
  • Able to build rapport quickly with colleagues and customers.
  • Able to negotiate effectively with customers to maximise margins.
  • Able to effectively collaborate with colleagues to achieve results.
  • Able to manage and respond quickly to changing/competing priorities .
  • Highly organized, able to independently plan own time.
  • Able to follow internal procedure & policy (CRM, Admin, Trial Policies, Customer Onboarding).
  • Able to present and clearly communicate information in speaking and writing.
  • Able to ensure tasks are completed on time and to a high-standard.
  • Able to use Excel, Outlook, Word and other MS Office products with high level of proficiency.
  • Able to undertake effective research.

General Attributes

  • Non-Negotiables: Action oriented, Builds strong relationships, Curious, Driven to learn, Empathetic, Investigative, Reflective, Resilient, Resourceful, Seeks feedback, Trustworthy.
  • Willing to take complete ownership of the role and drive success.
  • Grit and determination.
  • Persuasive with a ‘can do’ attitude.
  • Self-aware and reflective on successes and failures.
  • Not afraid to have challenging conversations.
  • Understands that upfront effort prevents issues down the line.
  • Committed to on-going personal and professional development.
  • Values team above self.

Who is RTS:

Recycle Track Systems (RTS) was developed with a desire to do better. We are committed to evolving and challenging the waste industry to be better stewards of the environment. We utilize technology, data analytics, sustainability expertise, and operational excellence to help people and businesses incorporate sustainability into their daily routines. Our passion for sustainability and innovation allows for us to guide businesses to a future of reaching a goal of zero waste.

Our technology platform utilizes sensors, GPS tracking, and highly engaged partner haulers to provide waste management and recycling services and track materials from their source to recycling and composting facilities. Our sustainability experts analyze the data generated by the platform to help our customers make tangible improvements to their waste management and recycling efforts. Ultimately, we are innovating to treat waste as a component material for other products in the circular economy so that as little as possible is deposited into landfills or incinerators.

What we need:

This position is a customer and hauling partner approach, excelling not only in the delivery of outstanding client support to both internal and external clients but also in actively executing functions related to account management, procurement, and processing service requests within our customer's processes. Your pivotal role involves managing the entire customer life cycle to ensure business retention. The team oversees a book of business, aiming to establish long-term partnerships and improve profit margins for both customers and vendors. Leveraging strategic thinking, the team maximizes operational efficiencies internally and externally by analyzing data to implement predictive solutions for our customers. The overarching goal is to enhance sustainability while elevating the overall customer and vendor experience.

This position is remote and available to candidates residing in the following states: Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Tennessee, and Virginia.

You excel at independently solving problems within a team environment, ensuring a high-quality experience for both customers and vendors. Your flexibility and openness to change are crucial as our business expands, and your willingness to contribute innovative thoughts and ideas will significantly influence both internal teams and external customers.   • Ensuring retention metrics and customers remain under long-term contracts.
  • Generating new opportunities within existing customer network for new sites, adding new services for existing customers.
  • Attending sales meetings and conducting business reviews with Key Accounts regularly.

  • Using customer and prospect CRM management software and updating relevant information held in these systems daily.

  • Attending and presenting at client meetings as well as at other company functions, networking events or as necessary to perform duties and manage customer portfolio.
  • Executing service requests directly with hauling partners, including but not limited to extra pickups, temporary bins, roll-off haul requests.
  • Other duties or projects as requested.

 

Is this you?

  • 2+ years experience in Account Management, procurement negotiations, and/or customer success.
  • Previous experience in the waste and recycling industry
  • Bachelor degree or equivalent
  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to provide excellent project execution via strong task prioritization and multi-tasking ability with minimal supervision
  • Demonstrates a willingness to not only ensure the job is done, but also accept responsibility for the results
  • Self-driven with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks

  • High degree of knowledge of service industry is preferred

Our client is a progressive global plastic recycling business with three distinct divisions: (1) Plastic Recycling; (2) Recycled Supply Chain Management; and (3) Recycled & Waste Plastic Feedstock. Being able to manage ongoing negotiations, incoming new opportunities and customer development all at the same time makes this role suitable for a skilled business development executive who is results driven and uses time effectively. Success is achieved through a disciplined and consistent approach to building relationships, utilising the CRM and hunting for your own leads to keep a full pipeline of opportunities.

The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-moving environment, react quickly to changing priorities, be able to follow internal processes and proactively manage risk. An excellent communicator, you will demonstrate an optimistic and persistent approach, always open to giving and receiving feedback on performance. Challenges are seen as an opportunity to learn. This role is suited to an ambitious individual who is motivated, goal driven and wants to be part of a values driven organisation in a growth industry.

Business Development & Delivery

  • Map the market and develop new suppliers & buyers from manufacturing (fibre, sheet & film), recycling & waste sectors.
  • Assess client suitability against strategy, quality requirements & size of opportunity.
  • Develop purchasing contracts for regular volumes of waste and recycled materials (particularly PET or rPET).
  • Execute sales for scrap & recycled PET (rPET) sourced from our client's global locations to licensed manufacturers and recyclers.
  • Actively seek out new opportunities and conduct market research through research, cold calling, networking, social media, attending conferences and trade fairs.
  • Maximise margin by using effective negotiation techniques.
  • Able to challenge customer views and counter objections to move towards closing a deal.
  • Actively engage with the greater team to develop skills and share knowledge.
  • Perform site visits to qualify, build relationships and discover market information.
  • Develop and enhance relationships by being creative, innovative and offering excellent service that is responsive and tailored to client needs.
  • Engage in constant and active risk management, to ensure the material is per the company and customer quality requirements.

Reporting & Management

  • Keep detailed logs in CRM of all activities constantly.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer information in CRM, including material requirements.
  • Provide feedback & market reports to Management.
  • Use knowledge of competitors and market to develop our client’s unique selling propositions.
  • Contribute to developing standard operating procedures to mitigate risk and ensure seamless workflow.

Requirements

Person Specification

Knowledge (Education & Related Experience)

  • At least 5 years’ experience in business development in raw materials supply.
  • Experience in recycled plastic or prime PET an advantage, not a requirement.
  • Experience of developing new accounts and long term contracts.

Skills & Abilities

  • Multilingual (fluent English is a requirement).
  • Able to use logic and reasoning to appraise situations .
  • Able to anticipate opportunities and risks.
  • Able to build rapport quickly with colleagues and customers.
  • Able to negotiate effectively with customers to maximise margins.
  • Able to effectively collaborate with colleagues to achieve results.
  • Able to manage and respond quickly to changing/competing priorities .
  • Highly organized, able to independently plan own time.
  • Able to follow internal procedure & policy (CRM, Admin, Trial Policies, Customer Onboarding).
  • Able to present and clearly communicate information in speaking and writing.
  • Able to ensure tasks are completed on time and to a high-standard.
  • Able to use Excel, Outlook, Word and other MS Office products with high level of proficiency.
  • Able to undertake effective research.

General Attributes

  • Non-Negotiables: Action oriented, Builds strong relationships, Curious, Driven to learn, Empathetic, Investigative, Reflective, Resilient, Resourceful, Seeks feedback, Trustworthy.
  • Willing to take complete ownership of the role and drive success.
  • Grit and determination.
  • Persuasive with a ‘can do’ attitude.
  • Self-aware and reflective on successes and failures.
  • Not afraid to have challenging conversations.
  • Understands that upfront effort prevents issues down the line.
  • Committed to on-going personal and professional development.
  • Values team above self.

We are seeking a high-performing, results-driven, business development professional to drive AIM Honeycomb's national growth strategy, expand our supplier network, and strengthen our presence across key markets throughout the United States. This is a high-impact role that combines sales, supplier relationship management, and market development.

  • You will prospect, develop, and convert new supplier relationships while expanding existing accounts.
  • You will lead bids, structure competitive tolling agreements, and negotiate pricing strategies
  • You will conduct regular onsite visits to supplier locations, including auto recyclers, auto dismantlers, scrap processors, and industrial accounts throughout the U.S.
  • You will develop territory and account growth plans through routine face-to-face engagement and proactive account development
  • You will strengthen supplier trust through transparency, consistent communication, and consistent relationship management
  • You will represent AIM Honeycomb at tradeshows, conferences, and supplier visits to expand market share
  • You will analyze market and competitor trends to optimize pricing, margins, and growth strategy

  • You will leverage supplier feedback and field intelligence to drive continuous improvement in commercial performance, service offerings, and supplier satisfaction

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or related field (preferred)
  • 5+ years of B2B sales, national account management, or business development experience.
  • Proven track record in prospecting, developing, and growing strategic or national accounts

  • Self-motivated, results-driven, and comfortable operating independently in a remote and field-based role
  • Willingness to travel nationally up to 60%

The Company

Our client is a progressive global plastic recycling business with three distinct divisions: (1) Plastic Recycling; (2) Recycled Supply Chain Management; and (3) Recycled & Waste Plastic Feedstock. Their expert global team combine impressive technical knowledge and capability with a passion for recycling and the circular economy. Our client is passionate about transforming waste into a valuable commodity, buying, selling and recycling scrap plastic.

Since our client started on their journey in 2005, they have developed a worldwide presence, serving hundreds of customers in over 50 countries. They have grown a strong, talented team who are highly trained, dedicated and loyal. They are headquartered in Hong Kong with operations and representation in Australia, Finland, Ireland, Turkey, Spain, Netherlands & UK. They operate a factory based in the UK specialising in the collection and recycling of plastic waste generated from industry and manufacturing.

Job Summary

Your role will be to procure and sell recycled plastics, with a particular focus on PET (rPET). You will be working closely with local and global teams, communicating with colleagues across the world every day, a highly collaborative and entrepreneurial mindset are key to being a top performer. You will develop relationships with material suppliers & buyers, assess their capabilities for a fit with our client's strategy and market demands.

Being able to manage ongoing negotiations, incoming new opportunities and customer development all at the same time makes this role suitable for a skilled business development executive who is results driven and uses time effectively. Success is achieved through a disciplined and consistent approach to building relationships, utilising the CRM and hunting for your own leads to keep a full pipeline of opportunities.

The ideal candidate will thrive in a fast-moving environment, react quickly to changing priorities, be able to follow internal processes and proactively manage risk. An excellent communicator, you will demonstrate an optimistic and persistent approach, always open to giving and receiving feedback on performance. Challenges are seen as an opportunity to learn. This role is suited to an ambitious individual who is motivated, goal driven and wants to be part of a values driven organisation in a growth industry.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business Development & Delivery

  • Map the market and develop new suppliers & buyers from manufacturing (fibre, sheet & film), recycling & waste sectors.
  • Assess client suitability against strategy, quality requirements & size of opportunity.
  • Develop purchasing contracts for regular volumes of waste and recycled materials (particularly PET or rPET).
  • Execute sales for scrap & recycled PET (rPET) sourced from our client's global locations to licensed manufacturers and recyclers.
  • Actively seek out new opportunities and conduct market research through research, cold calling, networking, social media, attending conferences and trade fairs.
  • Maximise margin by using effective negotiation techniques.
  • Able to challenge customer views and counter objections to move towards closing a deal.
  • Actively engage with the greater team to develop skills and share knowledge.
  • Perform site visits to qualify, build relationships and discover market information.
  • Develop and enhance relationships by being creative, innovative and offering excellent service that is responsive and tailored to client needs.
  • Engage in constant and active risk management, to ensure the material is per the company and customer quality requirements.

Reporting & Management

  • Keep detailed logs in CRM of all activities constantly.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer information in CRM, including material requirements.
  • Provide feedback & market reports to Management.
  • Use knowledge of competitors and market to develop our client’s unique selling propositions.
  • Contribute to developing standard operating procedures to mitigate risk and ensure seamless workflow.

Requirements

Person Specification

Knowledge (Education & Related Experience)

  • At least 5 years’ experience in business development in raw materials supply.
  • Experience in recycled plastic or prime PET an advantage, not a requirement.
  • Experience of developing new accounts and long term contracts.

Skills & Abilities

  • Multilingual (fluent English is a requirement).
  • Able to use logic and reasoning to appraise situations .
  • Able to anticipate opportunities and risks.
  • Able to build rapport quickly with colleagues and customers.
  • Able to negotiate effectively with customers to maximise margins.
  • Able to effectively collaborate with colleagues to achieve results.
  • Able to manage and respond quickly to changing/competing priorities .
  • Highly organized, able to independently plan own time.
  • Able to follow internal procedure & policy (CRM, Admin, Trial Policies, Customer Onboarding).
  • Able to present and clearly communicate information in speaking and writing.
  • Able to ensure tasks are completed on time and to a high-standard.
  • Able to use Excel, Outlook, Word and other MS Office products with high level of proficiency.
  • Able to undertake effective research.

General Attributes

  • Non-Negotiables: Action oriented, Builds strong relationships, Curious, Driven to learn, Empathetic, Investigative, Reflective, Resilient, Resourceful, Seeks feedback, Trustworthy.
  • Willing to take complete ownership of the role and drive success.
  • Grit and determination.
  • Persuasive with a ‘can do’ attitude.

  • Not afraid to have challenging conversations.

  • Committed to on-going personal and professional development.
  • Values team above self.
